results.name: Inventory manages product data and Stock management has only quantity controls
editing product data does not change recorded stock
Inventory creation starts at zero and all receiving stays in Stock management
unused product deletion is confirmed and persists

stock receipt and stock-out alter quantities without creating invoices and appear in logs
